Future<int> save(Object? x) async => 1;
void use(Object? x) {}

// CASE awaited_iife expect=fire
Future<void> h1(List<int> items) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await (() async {
      await save(item);
    })();
  }
}

// CASE awaited_local_function expect=fire
Future<void> h2(List<int> items) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    Future<void> step() async {
      await save(item);
    }
    await step();
  }
}

// CASE then_chain expect=fire
Future<void> h3(List<int> items) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    await save(item).then((r) => r);
  }
}

// CASE join_per_pass expect=fire
Future<void> h4(List<List<int>> groups) async {
  for (final group in groups) {
    await Future.wait(group.map(save));
  }
}

// CASE try_finally expect=fire
Future<void> h5(List<int> items) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    try {
      use(item);
    } finally {
      await save(item);
    }
  }
}

// CASE do_while expect=fire
Future<void> h6(List<int> items) async {
  var i = 0;
  do {
    await save(items[i]);
  } while (++i < items.length);
}

// CASE for_each_async_unawaited expect=pass
void h7(List<int> items) {
  items.forEach((item) async {
    await save(item);
  });
}

// CASE map_entries expect=fire
Future<void> h8(Map<String, int> m) async {
  for (final MapEntry(:key, :value) in m.entries) {
    await save('$key$value');
  }
}

// CASE cascade_await expect=fire
Future<void> h9(List<int> items, List<int> out) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    out.add(await save(item));
  }
}
